user_prompt: We need to understand how our upcoming engineering changes will affect our team's capacity and skill levels across the plant. Can you pull together an analysis that shows us the workforce impact from all the material and product modifications we have planned?

steps.step_name: We need to understand how our upcoming engineering changes will affect our team's capacity and skill levels across the plant. Can you pull together an analysis that shows us the workforce impact from all the material and product modifications we have planned?

method_trace.picked_reason: This data product directly synthesizes engineering change orders, component specifications, and production details to generate comprehensive workforce readiness metrics, competency gap analysis, and skill development requirements. It correlates product evolution with workforce capacity and skill impacts, and offers capabilities including assess-change-workforce, identify-skill-gaps, assess-capability-gaps, and forecast-workforce-readiness—precisely addressing your need for a complete analysis of workforce impact from engineering changes and material/product modifications across the plant.
